versions.changelog: Added 10 language support: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Arabic

Initial release of li_nvvideocodec - NVIDIA AV1 video batch compression tool.

- Supports batch compression of videos using NVIDIA NVENC hardware acceleration via FFmpeg.
- Offers three compression profiles (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive) with smart pre-compression validation.
- Compatible with Windows and Ubuntu Linux systems.
- Preserves original files, outputs to a separate directory, and displays real-time progress.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, requirements, and troubleshooting tips.
